name: Ōtawara (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōtawara city emblem in yellow: a ring open at the bottom with a pointed knot, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ōtawara, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 26 November 1969; the emblem dates from 1 January 1927.

features.role: Ōtawara city emblem — a ring open at the bottom with a pointed knot, like a stylised character
